processing: Individual illustrated human busts extracted using GrabCut segmentation and edge feathering. Original portrait boundaries retained; no missing anatomy or full bodies generated. Conventional Lanczos resampling on transparent 640x800 canvases. Pablito has a subtle green backing; Luca has a subtle blue backing. No generative redraw or recolouring of the characters. Small versions are 320x400.
